findings.detail: The source uses P + 9.88 % as the Reference Rate and Spread value, so a format rule that rejects this prime-rate abbreviation is over-narrow.

rationale: Class 1 single-cell adjudication. The raw source grid places P + 9.88 % in the Reference Rate and Spread column for Astra Acquisition Corp.; this matches the observed value rather than showing an extraction error. The flag is therefore a false alarm caused by rule scope/normalization not accepting the filing's prime-rate abbreviation.
